\begin{example} \end{example}[$p$-Laplacian Equation]

↗ def:kth-order-pde ↗ def:linear-semilinear-quasilinear-fully-nonlinear

1. ch1:1.2.1.b.3\group Examples of PDE

\[ \Div (|Du|^{p-2}Du) = 0. \] For a classical solution, the equation has the equivalent form \[ |Du|^{p-2}\Delta u + (p-2)|Du|^{p-4}D^2u(Du,Du) = 0. \] This is a second-order quasilinear equation, and for $p=2$ it becomes Laplace's equation. \end{example}
